visualCharacteristics.purpose: breadcrumb trail of parent page links ending in the current page

contentPattern.structure: one row per crumb with a link (or one cell holding a list of links); the last crumb is the current page and may be plain text; leave the block empty to build the trail from the URL path

usage: Top of most inner pages (about 200 pages: offices, about, services, insights).
reuseGuidance: Use on any inner page needing a parent trail. Do not put the trail in default content.
